description: behavioral-spec.md's REQ-004 'Complete repo-wide audit' table claims exhaustiveness ('A repo-wide grep -rl "HOME/.openclaw/.env" skills/ was run to close FIND-001 (iteration 4) for good... No further "found a 5th instance" iteration should be possible without a genuinely NEW file being added to the repo after this audit'). This claim is false as of the current repo state. Independently re-running the exact same grep pattern plus a trivial variant (hardcoded absolute path instead of $HOME) surfaced THREE more real instances of the identical vulnerable 'set -a; . <path-to-openclaw-env>; set +a' preamble that are absent from the table and NOT fixed via _shared/lib/load-instance-env.sh: (1) skills/earn/clip-promote/run.sh:19 -- `set -a; . "$HOME/.openclaw/.env" 2>/dev/null || true; set +a`; (2) skills/earn/x402-sell/serve-mainnet-boot.sh:10 -- `set -a; . /Users/anicca/.openclaw/.env 2>/dev/null || true; set +a` (this one also proves the audit's own grep methodology is not robust: the hardcoded /Users/anicca/ path contains no literal 'HOME' substring, so the exact grep the spec says it ran would not have found it either); (3) skills/earn/clip/launchd/ai.anicca.clip-producer.plist:6 -- a launchd ProgramArguments string that inlines `set -a; . /Users/anicca/.openclaw/.env; set +a; exec .../producer.sh` directly, ahead of producer.sh's own (also-vulnerable) sourcing. None of these three files are 'genuinely new' post-audit additions: clip-promote/run.sh and x402-sell/serve-mainnet-boot.sh both contain internal comments dated 2026-07-04, i.e. they existed before this feature's 2026-07-08 incident and before iteration-4's audit was written. earn/clip-promote is directly analogous to earn/video (which REQ-004 itself judged in-scope and fixed): it is a live earn-money loop with an overridable per-instance wallet var (CLIP_WALLET_SOLANA), so it is at least as plausibly ANICCA_HOME-relevant as earn/video was judged to be, yet it was never even entered into the audit table, fixed, or given a disposition.

evidence.snippet:
# env (own-identity only; PII is NOT scrubbed by the harness -- we keep it out of the RECORD subprocess).

set -u
DIR=/Users/anicca/anicca/skills/earn/x402-sell
# load CDP facilitator creds (existing account) -- never echoed
set -a; . /Users/anicca/.openclaw/.env 2>/dev/null || true; set +a

evidence.description: REQ-004's audit table and its closure claim ('This table is the closure of REQ-003/FIND-001... No further "found a 5th instance" iteration should be possible'), which the three files above directly contradict.
